# Meet Khunt

> Meet Khunt builds Shopify stores, landing pages, advertorials and Checkout Champ and Funnelish funnels for DTC brands and agencies. Send a project inquiry.

Meet Khunt is an ecommerce front-end developer working worldwide with DTC brands and agencies. He builds Shopify stores and pages, landing pages and advertorials for paid traffic, and complete sales funnels in Checkout Champ and Funnelish. Shipping for Luma Nutrition, Hume Health, Aavilo, Baby Gains & more.

## Services
- [Shopify development](https://meetkhunt.com/shopify-developer/): Hire Meet Khunt, a Shopify developer for DTC brands and agencies: store redesigns, product and collection pages, landing pages and Figma to Shopify builds.
- [Shopify store redesign](https://meetkhunt.com/shopify-store-redesign/): Shopify store redesign services for DTC brands: homepage, product and collection pages redesigned on an unpublished theme and launched without downtime.
- [White label Shopify development for agencies](https://meetkhunt.com/white-label-shopify-development/): White label Shopify development for agencies: an outsourced Shopify developer for themes, redesigns, Figma to Shopify and landing pages under your brand.
- [Checkout Champ development](https://meetkhunt.com/checkout-champ-developer/): Hire Meet Khunt, a Checkout Champ developer who builds DTC funnels end to end: advertorials, VSL pages, checkouts, upsells, subscriptions, tracking and A/B tests.
- [Landing page development](https://meetkhunt.com/landing-page-developer/): Hire Meet Khunt to design and build landing pages, advertorials and listicles for DTC brands running paid traffic, in Shopify, Funnelish, Checkout Champ and page builders.
- [Conversion optimization](https://meetkhunt.com/conversion-optimization/): Conversion rate optimization for DTC brands from Meet Khunt: page reviews, fixes in priority order, and A/B tests set up properly on Shopify stores, funnels and landing pages.
- [Claude-based advertorial system](https://meetkhunt.com/advertorial-system/): A Claude-based system that turns a reference advertorial, your product page and a marketing angle into a ready-to-edit advertorial or listicle in Shopify, Funnelish, GemPages, Replo or any page builder, so D2C brands and agencies can test more angles faster.
- [Landing pages and advertorials](https://meetkhunt.com/d2c/): I build conversion-ready landing pages and advertorials for D2C brands on Shopify. Send any reference page, get a live page in about an hour. Your first page is free.

## Work
- [All projects](https://meetkhunt.com/projects/): Ecommerce case studies.
- [Shopify Development Projects](https://meetkhunt.com/projects/shopify/): Shopify case studies by Meet Khunt: store redesigns, collection and product pages, and landing pages built for DTC brands.
- [WordPress Development Projects](https://meetkhunt.com/projects/wordpress/): WordPress case studies by Meet Khunt: business websites designed and built with clear structure, responsive layouts and easy navigation.
- [Landing Page & Advertorial Projects](https://meetkhunt.com/projects/landing-pages/): Landing page and advertorial case studies by Meet Khunt: pages built for cold paid traffic on Shopify, Funnelish and more.
- [Checkout Champ Funnel Projects](https://meetkhunt.com/projects/checkout-champ/): Checkout Champ funnels built by Meet Khunt for DTC brands: advertorials, sales pages, checkouts and post-purchase upsells.
- [Wix Website Projects](https://meetkhunt.com/projects/wix/): Wix website case studies by Meet Khunt: business websites designed in Figma and built in Wix with responsive layouts and clear service pages.
- [Squarespace Website Projects](https://meetkhunt.com/projects/squarespace/): Squarespace website case studies by Meet Khunt: websites for a photographer and a fitness coach, built with booking, services and content pages.

## Articles
- [Shopify CRO: Common Conversion Problems (and How to Fix Them)](https://meetkhunt.com/blog/shopify-cro-common-conversion-problems/): The most common reasons Shopify stores don't convert, how to spot each one in your own store, and what to fix first, from product pages to checkout.
- [Shopify Development vs Shopify Theme Customization](https://meetkhunt.com/blog/shopify-development-vs-theme-customization/): The difference between Shopify theme customization and Shopify development, what each can do, what each costs you, and how to tell which your store needs.
- [When Should a DTC Brand Redesign Its Shopify Store?](https://meetkhunt.com/blog/when-to-redesign-shopify-store/): The signs a DTC brand has outgrown its Shopify store, how to check each one, when a redesign isn't the answer, and how to time it safely.
- [How to Set Up Subscriptions in Checkout Champ (Frontend Guide)](https://meetkhunt.com/blog/checkout-champ-subscription-frontend-setup/): Learn how to add subscription options to Checkout Champ funnels using Subscribe elements, Subscribe & Save checkboxes, and custom frontend styling.
